# unifi_dns_policy (Resource)

Manages a DNS policy (record or forwarding rule) via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires a controller running 10.1.78+ with API-key authentication (Official API).

# An A record.
resource "unifi_dns_policy" "app" {
  type         = "A_RECORD"
  domain       = "app.example.com"
  ipv4_address = "10.0.0.20"
  ttl_seconds  = 300
}

# A DNS forwarding rule.
resource "unifi_dns_policy" "internal_forward" {
  type       = "FORWARD_DOMAIN"
  domain     = "corp.example.com"
  ip_address = "192.168.1.53"
}

# An MX record (disabled).
resource "unifi_dns_policy" "mail" {
  type               = "MX_RECORD"
  domain             = "example.com"
  mail_server_domain = "mail.example.com"
  priority           = 10
  enabled            = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) The DNS policy type. One of `A_RECORD`, `AAAA_RECORD`, `CNAME_RECORD`, `MX_RECORD`, `SRV_RECORD`, `TXT_RECORD`, `FORWARD_DOMAIN`. Changing the type forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `domain` (String) The domain the policy applies to. Required for all record types and for `FORWARD_DOMAIN`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the DNS policy is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address of the DNS server queries are forwarded to (`FORWARD_DOMAIN`).
- `ipv4_address` (String) IPv4 address for an `A_RECORD`.
- `ipv6_address` (String) IPv6 address for an `AAAA_RECORD`.
- `mail_server_domain` (String) Mail server domain for an `MX_RECORD`.
- `port` (Number) Service port for an `SRV_RECORD`.
- `priority` (Number) Priority (lower is preferred). Applies to `MX_RECORD` and `SRV_RECORD`.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol used by the service for an `SRV_RECORD` (e.g. `_tcp`).
- `server_domain` (String) Domain of the server running the service for an `SRV_RECORD`.
- `service` (String) Service name for an `SRV_RECORD` (e.g. `_sip`).
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `target_domain` (String) Target domain for a `CNAME_RECORD`.
- `text` (String) Text value for a `TXT_RECORD`.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Time to live in seconds. Applies to `A_RECORD`, `AAAA_RECORD` and `CNAME_RECORD`.
- `weight` (Number) Relative weight for records with the same priority (`SRV_RECORD`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using the site name and the DNS policy UUID: <site>:<id>
terraform import unifi_dns_policy.app default:11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555
```
